title: AUTO_MODE is a no-op: implement real auto-download
description: self.auto_mode is assigned (handlers.py:271), displayed (:403, :776), toggled (:775) and never read in any conditional - verified exhaustively. Meanwhile config.py:97-98 logs 'best match will be downloaded automatically', the /auto UI promises it, and README documents it. Every download requires two taps, always; there is no unattended path through the bot. Implement: in _do_slskd_search skip the picker and take ranked[0] when on; skip the approval step; persist the flag per-chat.

title: README quickstart pins Docker image 0.1.0 (February) - every copy-paste deploy is 6 months stale
description: The compose example in README.md pins image: drumsergio/telegram-slskd-local-bot:0.1.0, the very first release; latest is 0.10.5. Bump to the current release as part of the next release cut.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: No set_my_commands; /import and /cancel absent from /help and README
description: No BotCommand/set_my_commands anywhere, so Telegram's / autocomplete is empty. cmd_start lists only /auto /status /history /help (handlers.py:381-390) while create_bot registers seven including /import and /cancel (handlers.py:2060-2061); README.md:119-127 also omits them. The largest feature in the codebase (playlist import, ~350 lines) is undiscoverable - the ecosystem research agent reading the README concluded it did not exist.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: Live download progress is fetched every 3s and thrown away
description: DownloadStatus.percent_complete/bytes_transferred/average_speed are populated (slskd_client.py:371-379) but the only consumer is a DEBUG log (slskd_client.py:417). The user sees a static 'Downloading #N...' (handlers.py:912-921) for up to DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECS=600. Edit the message every ~10s with percent/speed, and surface the Queued state.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: Reject/dismiss delete from a read-only /downloads mount and break silently
description: docker-compose.yml:41 mounts /downloads:ro and prod (watchtower slskd_importer) is confirmed RW:false, yet reject does a bare os.remove (handlers.py:1224) and _dismiss_other_downloads another (:1246), both unguarded, inside callbacks with no error handler. Every reject silently does nothing (no edit, no history row) and rejected/abandoned FLACs pile up: 4.8GB / 100 files measured in prod. Fix: wrap both removes so the flow completes regardless, and decide the semantics - mount :rw if the bot should clean up, or drop deletion and let slskd own its dir.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Database deletes itself on any DatabaseError, including disk-full
description: persistence/database.py:76-79 catches sqlite3.DatabaseError and os.remove()s the DB. OperationalError (disk full, disk I/O error, readonly, locked) is a subclass, and the first write in the block is PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL - exactly what fails on a full/readonly volume. A full disk destroys all history and import jobs. Narrow to 'not a database'/'malformed' and rename aside (.corrupt-<ts>) instead of deleting; also handle -wal/-shm siblings.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: /import deadlocks permanently; /cancel cannot clear it
description: The job row is inserted BEFORE the user confirms (handlers.py:1407), so abandoning the confirm screen leaves a 'pending' row that blocks all future imports (handlers.py:1390-1397). A restart mid-import leaves an 'active' row. In both cases cmd_cancel only reads the in-memory dict (handlers.py:1450) and answers 'Nothing to cancel.' while the refusal message says to use /cancel. Fix: cmd_cancel falls back to import_repo.get_active_job(chat_id); reset stale jobs at startup; ideally insert the row only on confirm.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Download IDs restart at 1 after a restart; a stale Reject button deletes the wrong file
description: self._dl_counter=0 (handlers.py:279), _next_dl_id returns str(counter) (:946-949), and the ID is embedded in callback data inside Telegram messages that outlive the process. After restart, IDs are reissued and an old approval/reject button operates on an unrelated new download; reject does os.remove on it (handlers.py:1224). Use uuid4().hex[:8] or persist the counter.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Edited messages crash handlers (update.message is None)
description: Editing a previously sent message fires the text handler with update.message=None; handlers.py:461 does update.message.text.strip() -> AttributeError -> silence. Same for commands via update.message.reply_text. Use update.effective_message or ignore UpdateType.EDITED_MESSAGE explicitly. Fixing a typo in a song request currently produces total silence.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: /status crashes with AttributeError whenever a search is mid-flight
description: handlers.py:421 dereferences pending.track.artist but PendingSearch(track=None) is stored at handlers.py:511 (duplicate prompt), :539 (no Spotify match) and :583 (multiple Spotify candidates). With no error handler the command appears dead. Guard for track=None. Also: the same loop iterates all chats with no chat_id filter (handlers.py:418-426), leaking other users' activity in multi-user deployments.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: No telegram error handler registered; all handler crashes are invisible to users
description: No add_error_handler anywhere in src/. PTB's fallback is a single log line; the user gets no reply, no button change. Register a handler that logs the traceback and replies 'Something went wrong' when a chat is reachable.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: slskd HTTP client has no timeout; a hung slskd wedges the event loop forever
description: SlskdClient is constructed without timeout (slskd_client.py:117; slskd-api defaults to None = wait forever) and sync calls run directly on the event loop: enqueue_download at handlers.py:963 and handlers.py:1704, and the get_download_status poll at slskd_client.py:403 (every 3s, up to 200x per download). A hung (not down) slskd blocks every user until manual restart while /health stays green. Fix: timeout=15 at construction + asyncio.to_thread on those call sites (the rule already stated in CLAUDE.md).
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Health endpoint is a constant; assert real liveness
description: GET /health returns {'status':'healthy'} unconditionally (music_downloader/__main__.py:19-28) from its own daemon thread - it answers even when the event loop is wedged. Nothing acts on unhealthy anyway. Add a heartbeat timestamp from a JobQueue job + a cheap slskd probe, return 503 when stale, and consider an autoheal sidecar. Also add counters (consecutive zero-result searches, consecutive slskd errors) so a silent week of failures is visible.

title: Boot-time validation: slskd ping, Spotify probe, OUTPUT_DIR write test
description: Nothing validates connectivity or credentials at startup. A wrong SLSKD_API_KEY 401 is swallowed into return False (slskd_client.py:346-348) and rendered as 'The user might be offline' forever; revoked Spotify creds read as 'song not found' (metadata/spotify.py:126-128, handlers.py:534); os.makedirs succeeds on an existing read-only dir so an unwritable /music is discovered at first approval, not at boot. Fail loud at startup.

title: Bot-side wishlist/retry queue for tracks not found now
description: Soulseek is inherently flaky; every serious neighbor converged on retry-later (soularr stalled-timeout+denylist, slskdN native Wishlist, SoulSync wishlist, snapetech/slskd-retry-stuck-downloads). slskd itself has NO native wishlist (upstream slskd issues #957/#1611), so this must be bot-side state: store the failed query, re-run search_text() on a timer (JobQueue is currently unused), notify on hit.

title: Album/folder download via users.browse + transfers.enqueue(list)
description: slskd already exposes browsing a peer's full share (users.browse/directory) and batch enqueue of multiple files from one peer in a single call (transfers.enqueue accepts a list) - the two primitives that make 'download this whole album from this good peer' possible with zero new dependencies. Every mature neighbor (soularr, SoulSync, Tubifarry, sockseek) treats albums as the primary unit. Biggest validated feature gap.

title: Import auto-save mode + import progress in /status
description: The import chain advances only from a manual callback per track (handlers.py:1553, 1511, 1518) and uploads every <50MB file to Telegram as a preview (handlers.py:1765-1775): a 40-track album is 40 taps and ~1.5GB pushed through Telegram. /status never consults _active_import or import_repo (handlers.py:411-432) so imports are invisible. Add a mode selector on confirm (Review each / Auto-save all / Auto-save above score N) and an import progress block in /status. Shares machinery with real AUTO_MODE.

title: Concurrency: run searches via create_task and enable concurrent_updates (prereq: scope search cleanup)
description: Updates process strictly one at a time (concurrent_updates==1) and _do_slskd_search awaits its whole fallback ladder inline (handlers.py:612-684, each stage up to 40s; a zero-result search always burns the full timeout because the early-exit at slskd_client.py:207 cannot fire). A failed 5-word search freezes the bot for minutes; /cancel and all buttons are dead meanwhile. HARD PREREQUISITE: _cleanup_stale_searches (slskd_client.py:157-173) deletes EVERY search on the slskd server before each new one - under concurrency, search B cannibalizes search A and the unsuppressed state() call at slskd_client.py:228 turns it into SlskdUnavailableError. Scope cleanup to this client's own searches (or a per-client lock) BEFORE enabling concurrency.

title: Add a real screenshot/GIF; caveat the private live bot link; set repo homepage
description: Zero product screenshots/GIFs exist anywhere (docs/images has only branding assets); the entire product surface is a chat, so record one real session. The README links @slskdimporterbot with no note that it is allow-listed - strangers get silence and read it as broken. GitHub homepageUrl is empty; point it at Docker Hub.

title: CHANGELOG stops at 0.7.0 while the tag is v0.10.5
description: docs/CHANGELOG.md last entry is 0.7.0 (2026-02-23). Backfill 0.8.0-0.10.5 and keep it current with releases; the README links to this file.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: README/.env.example claim empty allowlist = open; code fails closed
description: README.md:102 lists TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS default as '(open)' and .env.example says 'If empty, anyone can use the bot' - both wrong: _is_authorized returns False when empty (handlers.py:311-313) and config.py:102 logs deny-all. A day-one user following the README gets denied on every message.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: Artist - Title prompt is a modal with no exit that eats the next message
description: _handle_direct_search sets _awaiting_direct_metadata and asks for 'Artist - Title' with no keyboard (handlers.py:1288-1295). The next free text is consumed as metadata (handlers.py:468-496); without ' - ' the typed text silently becomes the ARTIST of a search for the PREVIOUS query. Add a Cancel button, mention /cancel, and reject unparseable input instead of guessing.

title: Unauthorized reply should include the user's Telegram ID
description: handlers.py:318 replies 'You are not authorized' without the user ID, so a self-hoster cannot discover the value to put in TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS. Include the numeric ID in the denial.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: 'No results found' is a dead end and often untrue
description: The empty-result message ships with no reply_markup (handlers.py:699-707 and 1332-1338) while the Spotify-miss path does offer buttons. The scorer silently drops results containing EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS or >30s duration mismatch (scorer.py:109-113, 126-132; defaults config.py:74-78), so live/acoustic/album-cut tracks report 'no results' when plenty were found and discarded. Attach [Search Soulseek directly] [Retry] and count what was filtered so the message can say so.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36 (escape-hatch buttons + honest filter note); the filtered-results count was deliberately omitted as YAGNI

title: New text kills all in-flight work silently; abandoned messages stay frozen
description: handle_text unconditionally cancels the chat's operations (handlers.py:499) and every superseded flow exits via bare return at the _is_stale sites without editing the message it abandons. The chat fills with messages frozen at 'Looking up...' / 'Downloading #1...' and queued-up requests are dropped without notice. Cheap fix: edit abandoned messages to 'Superseded by a newer search'. (Real per-chat queue is tracked separately.)
close_reason: Cheap fix shipped in PR #36 (superseded messages edited); the real per-chat queue remains tracked in tsb-edd

title: Telegram RetryAfter (flood control) is never caught
description: _safe_edit/_safe_query_edit (handlers.py:79-87, 95-103) catch BadRequest/TimedOut/NetworkError, but RetryAfter derives directly from TelegramError and escapes into the no-error-handler void. Likely triggers: the fallback ladder editing the same message 4+ times rapidly, or import's per-track uploads. Also every _safe_edit call site ignores the False return, so flows proceed as if the user saw the message.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Import 'Save' button on a failed track strips the keyboard and freezes the job
description: On enqueue failure (handlers.py:1706-1711) and file-not-found (:1734-1737) the bot renders build_import_track_keyboard including Save while source_path is None. Tapping Save hits :1529-1532 which edits without reply_markup (stripping all buttons) and never advances the import. Render build_import_skip_keyboard (already exists, keyboards.py:149-158) in that state and preserve markup in _edit_approval_message.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: Stale results keyboard downloads from the CURRENT search (cross-wire)
description: self.pending is one slot per chat (handlers.py:274) and _handle_download_selection resolves the tapped index against it with no message identity check (handlers.py:883-909) even though PendingSearch.message_id exists. Tapping #3 on an old results message downloads result #3 of the NEWER search; out-of-range taps return silently (:906-907). Stamp a search id into callback_data and reply 'this list is out of date' on mismatch.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0

title: Settle slskd behavior questions: transfer resume across restart; 404-vs-stale on deleted search; flood-control incidence
description: Three unknowns from the ops review, each with a concrete probe: (1) restart slskd mid-transfer and watch /api/v0/transfers/downloads to learn resume semantics; (2) run two concurrent searches against the live instance and grep the bot log for SlskdUnavailableError to confirm the cleanup race; (3) current logs show 0 RetryAfter hits but rotate at 150MB, so inconclusive - re-grep after progress-edit feature ships.

title: find_similar runs os.listdir + SequenceMatcher on the event loop per message; breaks on subfoldered library
description: handlers.py:503 walks the output dir synchronously on every text message - a stall risk as the library grows - and uses os.listdir (not os.walk), so duplicate detection silently stops working if the library is ever organized into subfolders. Move off the loop and decide flat-vs-recursive explicitly.

title: Zero-result searches always burn the full timeout; slskd transfers never cancelled on abandon
description: With zero results current_count never changes so the stabilization early-exit at slskd_client.py:207 cannot fire - the miss path is the slowest path. Separately the bot never calls transfers.cancel_download, so downloads abandoned bot-side may complete in slskd and orphan files. Add an early-exit for prolonged zero-result states and cancel slskd-side transfers on abandon/timeout.

title: Per-chat download queue + /queue instead of kill-on-new-message
description: The natural 'queue up five songs' gesture keeps only the last request (handlers.py:499 cancels everything). A per-chat FIFO with a /queue view is the real fix; the superseded-message edit (tracked separately) is the stopgap.

title: /history: re-download buttons, timestamps, failed-vs-rejected icons, pagination
description: cmd_history prints icon+filename for a hardcoded last 10 (handlers.py:434-450). HistoryRecord already carries artist/title/album/source_user/duration/size/created_at (history_repo.py:8-20) - none shown, no buttons. Statuses failed/file_not_found/process_failed all collapse to the same icon as rejected (:447), but one is worth retrying and the other was deliberately discarded. Add a re-download button per row (query reconstructible from artist/title).

title: Format fallback chain with explicit user confirmation (FLAC -> MP3 320)
description: Today a no-FLAC search is a dead end. The validated interactive pattern (eeegoloauq/music-bot) asks before downgrading rather than silently substituting - fits a chat where the user is present. Configurable ordered chain like soularr's config.

title: Route pasted Spotify links in handle_text
description: A pasted Spotify URL goes into Spotify TEXT search as a literal query string (handle_text never checks is_spotify_url; handlers.py:461-514), track URLs are rejected by /import (playlist.py:150-157 matches only playlist/album), and nothing mentions /import. Detect URLs in handle_text: track -> exact-metadata search; album/playlist -> import confirm flow.

title: README says MAX_RESULTS default 5; code default is 10
description: README.md:110 documents default 5, config.py:62 defaults 10, .env.example ships 5. Align the docs with the code.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: CLAUDE.md claims FastAPI+uvicorn health endpoint; it is stdlib http.server
description: CLAUDE.md Tech Stack lists 'FastAPI + uvicorn (health check endpoint)' but neither is in pyproject.toml nor imported anywhere; the health server is stdlib (music_downloader/__main__.py:10,19-37). This stale line already misled one code audit into a false 'dead dependency' finding. Note: CLAUDE.md is LynxPrompt-generated - fix the LynxPrompt source too or a regen reverts it.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #36, released in v0.11.0

title: MAX_RESULTS=0 causes ZeroDivisionError in _format_results
description: handlers.py:1963 divides by max_results with no validation floor. Validate config to >=1 at startup.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #35, released in v0.11.0
